output.title: HTTP challenge RBAC value already configured
output.content: The upstream change adds the `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` helm value feature to cert-manager. Your environment has this value key already set, meaning you are actively using this configuration parameter. Review your current `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` setting and verify it produces the expected RBAC behavior after upgrading to v1.18.0, particularly whether HTTP-01 challenges are correctly handled with the desired pod creation permissions dropped.
